new_C_helper_entry_adapter_must_prove: Correct relocated own-PC GP/SP/data/CSR anchor targets and exact bounded forward copy/zero memory effects.
A real helper call return link and adapter continuation that reaches original186F8 or an explicitly linked equivalent; a C RET is not the original fallthrough.
Preserve or establish source A0/A1 final values; their deadness at actual installed ROM is unproved.
Prove GP/SP and all relevant untouched register obligations, additional stack access validity, no hidden calls or unresolved libc helpers, and actual native write sets.
If using local deadness of oldA2/T0/incomingRA, state the normal-path observation scope; this is not asynchronous or whole-entry ABI equivalence.
Preserve ordered original CSR operations, clock call/return and MEPC assignment without replacing terminal ROM jump with CALL, direct-main jump or local MRET.
For relocated clock call/link changes, prove the ROM does not require originalRA18724 or reproduce the required boundary state.
Independently bind installed ROM, RAM/stack, clock/MMIO, privilege, interrupt and hardware/OTA behavior.
